name: Instagram Sync
description: Imports Instagram posts into the Drupal site.
project_description:
This module allows you to import Instagram posts as a custom entity to your website. You can use them in views, blocks, etc.

 Features 
 
 Import posts, videos, carousels 
 Posts auto-sync by chosen period 
 The ability to avoid loading of unnecessary media data 
 
 Available login methods: 
 
 Instagram API with Instagram Login 
 Instagram API with Facebook Login (TBD) 
 
 Active development 
 
 Instagram API with Facebook Login 
 Default views for fast website embedding 
 Token generation feature 
 
 Post-Installation 
 Generate long-live access token using Instagram API . Use the configuration page and insert the token.
